cinderfall.incomplete: No exact type match. Resistance types are drawn from a fixed dictionary (CONFIG.PF2E.resistanceTypes) that includes "bleed" (all bleed damage, not persistent-only) and "persistent-damage" (all persistent damage, not bleed-only) as separate literals, but no combined "persistent bleed only" type exists. Either literal would be broader than the card's stated text in one direction or the other -- shipping either would repeat the exact over-broad-modifier mistake this program's own guide flags (Third Arm).
